verdict.rationale:
Superhuman ships a built-in AI assistant that auto-labels, archives, drafts replies, answers questions, and now supports building proactive agents from triggers/connectors with admin governance, all documented extensively as first-party features (docs-2,6,25,27,38,61,62,64). This directly matches delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant beyond simple automation.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating the delegation/agent-building experience (community evidence covers general product sentiment, not this AI-assistant delegation feature).
